Wardrobe Curator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a personalized capsule wardrobe planning tool with guided style discovery, capsule building, outfit planning, and targeted shopping advice.
- Outputs a structured wardrobe plan, including a style profile, capsule blueprint, outfit formulas, prioritized shopping list, and seasonal maintenance checklist.
- Includes templates for work, casual, travel, and seasonal capsule scenarios.
